Interface SyncDataSource.ValidationMaintainer<U>

Type Parameters:
U - The type of user object used by the application
Enclosing interface:
SyncDataSource<U,T>
public static interface SyncDataSource.ValidationMaintainer<U>
Maintains a subscription to an entity set. This interface watches every event to every entity in every entity set, determining if the event is relevant to the state of the subscription. This interface is not responsible for determining whether an event for the subscription's type is included in the subscription--just whether the event changes the set of entities available to the subscription.
